source_read: https://oodleswok.co.uk/nutritional-information/ (page, fetched fresh 2026-10-08, robots.txt checked) and the PDF it links, https://oodleswok.co.uk/assets/oodles-wok-nutrition-jan-2025.pdf (Nutritional Data V03, created 31 Jan 2025); allergen page https://oodleswok.co.uk/allergen-information/ re-fetched for the link only
not_verifiable: Allergens are link-only (nothing published), so there are no allergen marks to verify.
notes: Own parser of the page's 31 <table>s (not the script's) equals items.csv on all 81 rows x 9 figures (kcal, kJ, protein, fat, sat fat, carbs, sugars, fibre, salt); the PDF's unrounded cells (own pdftotext -layout read) round to the page's printed cells for every row, single-portion rows included. 77 published + 4 held back (Torpedo Prawns, Oodles Crispy Chicken x3: printed kcal contradicts both kJ and macros; kJ is published for this chain so the hold stays). PDF-only dishes (wraps, bento, dumplings, 7 wings, haloumi fries...) are not on the page and stay unpublished.
